cues: Fixed template-like structure: Classification (dominant constraint, worst failure), Key decisions table with 'Default' and 'Revisit trigger' columns, first end-to-end slice, phases, cross-cutting, AI layer, Deferred
Phase 0 is a 'first end-to-end slice' through all tiers with day-zero observability and an explicit exit check, which is typical of a prescribed walking-skeleton methodology
Each phase has 'Unlocks', 'Depends on', 'Tasks (widest first)' and 'Exit check' fields, applied uniformly and with testable criteria
Cross-cutting matrix of security/observability/reproducibility/resilience per phase, plus explicit '(AI) N/A' rows and a conditional AI layer section that look like checklist items
Deferred section where every item has a 'Pull forward when' trigger, and decisions are flagged as irreversible to settle before the data format locks
